name: piano-trainer
description: Ear training for jazz piano at a MIDI keyboard

scripts.build: pnpm --filter web build && pnpm --filter ios build:shim
scripts.check: pnpm --filter web check && pnpm --filter ios check
scripts.test: pnpm --filter web test && pnpm --filter ios test
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter web test:unit && pnpm --filter ios test:unit
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter ios build:shim && pnpm --filter web test:e2e
